title: A pretty carpet
visual_consistency: A warm illustrated-realism domestic comedy in the same gentle watercolor children's book style used by the course: hand-painted texture, soft brush strokes, slight grain, warm pastel colors, painterly daylight, and cinematic storybook composition. Avoid flat vector art, icon-like drawing, hard-edged classroom clip art, schematic diagrams, or advertisement-like room-decor images. No readable text, letters, numbers, book titles, book-cover words, box labels, room signs, brand marks, speech bubbles, captions, UI panels, blank label areas, fake writing, or empty text boxes anywhere in the image. The recurring narrator is a book-loving older student or young adult in his early 20s, light skin, slim average build, tired but gentle face, short dark-brown slightly messy hair, wearing the same dusty teal sweater over a cream shirt, dark trousers, and simple indoor shoes; he looks hardworking, overwhelmed by books, mildly embarrassed, and amused. The recurring sister is warm and playful in her late teens, light skin, slim build, round kind face, shoulder-length chestnut hair tied loosely back, wearing the same soft coral cardigan over a pale blouse and navy skirt; she looks helpful, surprised, and kind rather than mocking. The small new upstairs room remains visually consistent with plain cream walls, soft daylight, several unlabeled moving boxes, many colorful text-free books, and one large old wooden bookcase.
